title.narrative: Strengthened institutional capacity of workers' organizations

description.narrative: ILO will support trade unions of Kazakhstan, under the umbrellas of the Federation of Trade Unions of the Republic of Kazakhstan (FPRK) and the Kazakhstan Confederation of Labour (KKT) in designing and articulating their proposals to shape the Government policies that facilitate creation of decent jobs particularly for youth and women, formalization of informal employment making social protection universally accessible to all workers irrespective of their employment status. ILO will also support the trade unions in modernizing their structures, charters and internal regulations as well as to establish new services and improve existing ones to be more attractive to new groups of workers, including workers in the platform and informal economy and migrant workers.
